name: openfn-language-registry-stack
description: OpenFn local adaptor monorepo for Registry Stack services.

scripts.check: npm run check:evidence && npm run check:breg && npm run check:casework && npm run check:events && npm run check:pilot
scripts.check:pilot: node --experimental-vm-modules --no-warnings --test pilot/test/*.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s pilot/test -p "*_test.py"
scripts.pack:dry-run: npm run pack:dry-run --workspace @openfn/language-registry-evidence && npm run pack:dry-run --workspace @openfn/language-registry-breg && npm run pack:dry-run --workspace @openfn/language-registry-casework
